subject: Scheduling: SE technical demo — engineer roster, timezones, and procurement pre-reqs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme-robotics.com>, laura.chen@acme-robotics.com
Cc: procurement@acme-robotics.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: [ACME-2345] Scheduling SE technical demo — proposed slots + pre-reqs

Hi all,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We'd like to lock a 60–75 minute technical demo with your engineering team to cover: architecture fit, query patterns, latency/cost expectations, and a short Q&A on integration.

High-level asks:
- Please confirm 1–2 engineer attendees from Acme (ideally someone who owns infra/network).
- We need a short procurement contact to start PO paperwork.
- Security/procurement have asked for a SOC2 excerpt and a demo checklist (attached).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Option A: Wed 20 May, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Option B: Thu 21 May, 08:30–09:45 PT
- Option C: Fri 22 May, 16:00–17:15 PT (falls later for EU folks)

Marcus (SE) and Priya (tech lead), can you confirm which slots you'd prefer / whether you want a 30-minute internal dry run first?

Attaching: SE-demo-checklist.xlsx and acme-scope-and-roles.pdf (outline of roles we suggest).

Next step: once we agree a slot I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook for VPN/allowlist steps.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme-robotics.com>, laura.chen@acme-robotics.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [ACME-2345] Scheduling SE technical demo — proposed slots + pre-reqs

Ben — thanks. I can do Option A (Wed 10:00 PT) and Option B (Thu 08:30 PT). Prefer Wed if Acme engineers can make it.

A couple of notes from SE side:
- Agenda we usually follow: 10m intros, 25m architecture walk + live short demo, 20m deep-dive on integration + Q&A, 10m next steps.
- For the live/demo piece we will need read-only access to a small sample dataset or a sandbox API key (no PII). If that's not possible we'll mock with sanitized data.
- I'd like a 30-minute SE-only dry run Tues 19 May 15:00 PT to align the sequence and who demos which part.

If the customer confirms engineers + VPN allowlist details, I'll add the dry run invite and the demo calendar hold.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — Wed 20 May 10:00 PT works best for our infra lead (Laura will join too).

- Our security team will need a SOC2 (Type II) excerpt and the short checklist before the demo so they can sign off on the allowlist/traffic plan.
- Procurement: please send the PO template and any standard T&Cs up front — procurement@acme-robotics.com is on copy.

- Miguel Reyes (SRE) — tentative

Thanks,
